name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: ON-COMPOSE-ERROR-TRIGGER BUILD, not for production: v0.4.25's browser.compose.onAfterSend never fired for a signing failure (confirmed against comm-central's source: the JS catch block returns before the "aftersend" event that API is built on ever dispatches). This build hooks lower, at the same layer Thunderbird's own compose window code uses: nsIMsgComposeStateListener, registered via gMsgCompose.RegisterStateListener() -- ComposeProcessDone(aResult) fires with the real nsresult of the send, including a finishCryptoEncapsulation failure, driven by nsMsgCompose's own completion notification rather than the JS try/catch that swallows it.
